title: An unconditional skip marker added next to a source change is flagged
text:
diff --git a/app/core.py b/app/core.py
--- a/app/core.py
+++ b/app/core.py
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
 def total(items):
-    return sum(item.price for item in items)
+    return sum(item.price * item.qty for item in items)
diff --git a/tests/test_core.py b/tests/test_core.py
--- a/tests/test_core.py
+++ b/tests/test_core.py
@@ -1,5 +1,6 @@
 import unittest
 class T(unittest.TestCase):
+    @unittest.skip("flaky")
     def test_total(self):
         self.assertEqual(total([Item(2, 1)]), 2)
intent: 合計金額の計算に数量を反映する。
rationale: Switching a test off with an unconditional skip keeps the file but removes the check. The intent does not ask for it.
